groundSolidJoistStudy.basis: Short northern suspended ground-floor bays use 45 × 295 mm solid C24 at 400 mm centres. This uses about 43% less net timber than the earlier 95 × 245 mm option; both are compared in G02. Garage vehicle bays remain the separate G01 concrete-deck concept. Same FFL, ceiling datum and support network; joists are 5 mm shallower than the earlier 300 mm I-joist reservation. Experimental floor-load candidate; no complete floor-system approval.
groundSolidJoistStudy.loadBasis: Assumed superimposed floor Gk 0.75 / 1.00 / 1.35 kPa, including a lightweight-partition allowance, plus joist self-weight at 4.2 kN/m³. Alternative Qk 1.50 / 1.50 / 2.00 kPa or one 2.00 kN midspan point on a single joist. The point and distributed cases are separate sensitivities, not simultaneous. Heavy walls, vehicles and plant are excluded from these timber bays. These are assumptions, not certified statutory bounds.
groundSolidJoistStudy.limits: Limited C24 bending, shear and deformation screen: Emean 11000 / Gmean 690 N/mm²; SC1; kdef 0.6; psi2 0.3; gammaM 1.3; kcr 0.67; kh=ksys=1. Instant <= min(L/300,8 mm), final <= min(L/250,10 mm) are study targets. Vibration, restraint, floor diaphragm, service penetrations, bearing and compatible hanger/ledger fixings, fire/acoustic/moisture assemblies and the onward load route remain unverified. No construction approval.
